name: SoftReviewed Multi-Engine Indexing
author: jovin george

sections.description:
SoftReviewed Multi-Engine Indexing notifies Google, Bing, and Yandex the instant you publish, update, or delete a post or page on your WordPress website.

Instead of waiting days or weeks for search engine bots to crawl your XML sitemap, SoftReviewed Multi-Engine Indexing pushes real-time notifications directly to search engine crawlers via their official APIs within seconds.

Key Capabilities

  • Ultra-Lightweight: Clean, single-file modular architecture built with native PHP (< 750 lines).
  • Zero External Dependencies: Native OpenSSL token signing for Google’s Indexing API — no bulky Google SDK or third-party composer dependencies.
  • Bing & Yandex (IndexNow): Native IndexNow integration automatically generates and hosts your verification key file (/<key>.txt) and notifies api.indexnow.org.
  • Google Indexing API: Full support for Google Service Accounts (URL_UPDATED and URL_DELETED events).
  • Non-Blocking Queue: Submissions are queued via WordPress Cron to ensure your post editor never slows down or waits on external network requests.
  • Manual Bulk Submitter: Quickly paste and submit up to 50 URLs at once for rapid re-indexing.
  • Live Audit Log: Real-time log displaying exact HTTP response codes and verification statuses for every submission.

External services

This plugin connects to third-party search engine APIs to provide automated URL indexing services:

  1. Google Indexing API & Google OAuth 2.0:

    • What it does: Submits real-time crawl requests to Google when posts or pages are published, updated, or removed.
    • Data sent: The public URL of the published or modified post, the action type (URL_UPDATED or URL_DELETED), and a cryptographic OAuth 2.0 assertion token signed with your private Google Service Account key.
    • When it is sent: Automatically upon publishing, updating, or trashing content, or manually when using the bulk submission tool.
    • Terms & Privacy:
      • Google APIs Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/terms
      • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  2. IndexNow API (Microsoft Bing & Yandex):

    • What it does: Instantly notifies Bing, Yandex, and other participating search engines of new or modified URLs.
    • Data sent: The site host domain, the public URL of the modified content, the auto-generated site verification key, and the key file location URL.
    • When it is sent: Automatically upon publishing, updating, or trashing content, or manually when using the bulk submission tool.
    • Terms & Privacy:
      • IndexNow Protocol Information: https://www.indexnow.org/
      • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement
      • Yandex Privacy Policy: https://yandex.com/legal/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the softreviewed-multi-engine-indexing folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > SoftReviewed Multi-Engine Indexing.
  4. Configure your indexing preferences:
    • Bing & Yandex: The IndexNow key is generated automatically on activation. Make sure the status shows “working”.
    • Google: Paste your Google Cloud Service Account JSON credentials into the Google Service Account field.
  5. Click Save settings. Your site is now ready for instant search engine indexing!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace other SEO plugins?

SoftReviewed Multi-Engine Indexing works seamlessly alongside all major SEO plugins (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO, The SEO Framework). It focuses solely on real-time API indexing, allowing your main SEO plugin to handle metadata and schema.

How does IndexNow work?

IndexNow is an open protocol initiated by Microsoft Bing and supported by Yandex and other search engines. The plugin automatically generates a unique authentication key and serves it at https://yoursite.com/<key>.txt. When content is published, Bing is alerted and immediately shares the signal with participating engines.

What Google pages does the Google Indexing API support?

Google officially documents the Indexing API for JobPosting and BroadcastEvent (livestream) structured data, but many site owners report accelerated indexing for standard articles and pages. Sitemaps and Google Search Console remain standard routes alongside this API.

Does this slow down the post publishing process?

No. Submissions are pushed to a background queue using WordPress transients and cron scheduling (srmei_submit_event), so clicking “Publish” or “Update” in the block editor remains instant.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Automated Bing and Yandex IndexNow integration with dynamic key file serving.
  • Native OpenSSL-signed Google Indexing API service account integration.
  • Non-blocking cron queuing system.
  • Manual bulk submission tool.
  • Live audit and history log.
